TITLE: 2Box
HINT_NONE: No moves left — reset the level
HELP_GOAL: Two boxes, two pads. Slide the coral box onto the coral pad and the gold box onto the gold pad. When both sit on their pads, the level is solved.
HELP_MOVE: One gesture moves both boxes: they slide the same way until they hit a wall, the edge of the field or each other. The second box often acts as a brake for the first — that is what most solutions are built on.
HELP_COMPASS: This is the game compass: W is west, S is south, N is north and E is east. The hint under the field shows the W and S axes, and the letters on the sides of the boxes repeat the same directions — they show how a box is turned. The level can be rotated: drag with the mouse or use two fingers to check the sides and look behind the boxes.
HELP_CELLS: Besides plain tiles the field has cells with mechanics. Every episode brings its own set:
HELP_CTRL_MOVE: Swipe on the field or use the arrow keys to make a move.
HELP_CTRL_ORBIT: Two fingers or mouse drag rotates the level around the vertical axis so you can look behind the boxes.
HELP_CTRL_UNDO: Undo takes back the previous move; reset starts the level over.
HELP_CTRL_HINT: The «?» button shows the first move of the shortest solution when one exists.
HELP_TIP: Stuck? Step back: many levels are solved by an unexpected first move. Hotkeys: R — reset, Esc — pause.
DEBUG_GENERATE_FAILED: Could not build a level with this set. Try another difficulty.
MECH_PORTAL_DESC: Entering sends the box to the paired exit.
MECH_TRAP_DESC: A box stops and skips two moves.
